priorityList: Interrupt with Mind Freeze whenever the target is casting.
Cast Reaper's Mark if Pillar of Frost is nearly ready (<= 1.5s).
Cast Pillar of Frost on cooldown, ensuring it is synced with Reaper's Mark or Breath of Sindragosa.
Cast Breath of Sindragosa while Pillar of Frost is active if Runic Power is 60 or higher.
Cast Remorseless Winter if Gathering Storm is talented or if multiple enemies are present.
Cast Frostwyrm's Fury during Pillar of Frost, ideally when other temporary buffs like Unholy Strength are active.
Use Empower Rune Weapon if Runes are depleted (< 2) or to sustain resources during Pillar of Frost or Breath of Sindragosa.
Use offensive Trinkets and combat Potions during Pillar of Frost windows.
Cast Obliterate if you have 2 stacks of Killing Machine or if Killing Machine is active and you have at least 3 Runes.
Cast Howling Blast whenever Rime is active.
Cast Frost Strike if Shattering Blade is talented and the target has 5 stacks of Razorice.
Cast Obliterate whenever a Killing Machine proc is active.
During Pillar of Frost (with Obliteration talented), if Killing Machine is NOT active, cast Howling Blast or Frost Strike to trigger a proc.
Cast Frost Strike to dump Runic Power if near cap (deficit < 30) or to spend resources when Obliterate is unavailable.
Cast Obliterate as your primary filler and use Raise Dead on cooldown.
